Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression redundantly combines two time expressions; use the shorter time phrase. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，this refers to a concrete group of people in that period, so use the plural noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 孟子妈妈：孟子的妈妈，when a proper name modifies a kinship noun, add 的 to form the attributive phrase. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see”; the completed observation also takes 了. [vocab list]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：孟子和他的妈妈搬家了，his mother was mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence; 的 also marks the possessive relationship. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，老是 describes a repeated routine, so use the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友，this is a cause-and-effect relation, which needs the paired connector because...therefore..., rather than an unfinished although clause. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代的时候 redundantly combines a historical period with 时候; 在古代 is correct.
Here 人 refers to the people of that period, so 人们 is required under the teacher's rule.
孟子妈妈 is an acceptable way to refer to Mencius's mother, so adding 的 is optional rather than a correction.
With an observed result or fact as its object, 看到 is the appropriate verb rather than 看.
Changing only 孟子妈妈 to 他的妈妈 leaves the redundant repeated explicit subject that the teacher required to be omitted.
老是 describes a habitual action, so it should not take completed-action 了.
虽然 is inappropriate here, and the revised 因为……所以 construction correctly expresses the cause and result.
